extractedText: Back Sign up to the March 2026 Performance Assurance Webinar on 19/03/2026 Published on 19 February 2026 By Jenny Hyskaj • Reading Time: Less Than a Minute Read • Published on Feb 19, 2026 12:02:00 PM The Code Manager is hosting a Performance Assurance Webinar on 19 March 2026 (13:30-15:00). Where the Performance Assurance team will be listening and responding to your views as well as discussing upcoming activities including: the Data Quality, Cross-Code Collaboration, and SDEP/Escalations Deep Dives among others. View the full agenda and register your interest on the Events Page of the REC Portal.
